user.title: Deeper Connect
user.description: Enter the API URL, username and your normal AtomOS password.

reauth_confirm.title: Deeper Connect
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the API URL, username and your normal AtomOS password.

reconfigure.title: Deeper Connect
reconfigure.description: Enter the API URL, username and your normal AtomOS password.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect or API response is incompatible.
error.invalid_auth: Deeper rejected login. Check your username and password.
error.invalid_url: Enter an http(s) API base URL, optionally ending in /api.
error.invalid_password: Password is empty or too long for RSA encryption.

init.title: Deeper Connect options
init.description: Configure the integration or add a service and its route.

settings.title: Deeper Connect options
settings.description: Tunnel refresh is manual by default. Optionally enable automatic route repair and set its interval in minutes. Sensor polling only reads status.

data.auto_refresh: Automatically refresh tunnels and repair routes

application.title: Choose application
application.description: Choose an application from the Deeper catalog and its route. Saving applies the route on the device and adds a routing selector to its page.

custom_service.title: Add custom service
custom_service.description: Enter a name, service domains (one per line), and a route. Saving adds or updates Deeper domain rules. Use domain names without http://, paths, or *. Custom services support direct routing or a specific tunnel.

error.application_missing: The application is no longer in the Deeper catalog.
error.operation_failed: Could not apply the route. Check the tunnel and device availability. Some domain rules may have been applied; saving can be retried.
error.invalid_domains: Enter 1–50 valid domain names without URLs, IP addresses, or wildcards.
error.invalid_name: Enter a name between 1 and 60 characters.
error.name_exists: A service with this name already exists.
error.domain_in_use: A domain is already managed by another custom service.

abort.cannot_connect: The integration is not loaded or the device is unavailable. Restore the connection first.

routing_option_unavailable.message: The selected route is no longer available. Refresh the list and choose an available option.
